evals.name: expo-settings-mobile
evals.prompt: Devo rifare la schermata impostazioni della mia app Expo per seguire le partite di calcio: notifiche per squadra preferita (gol, inizio partita, risultato finale), lingua, tema chiaro/scuro, gestione account e abbonamento premium. Prima di toccare il codice fammi vedere qualche proposta di design.
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML with 2-4 structurally different mobile settings designs in tabs, realistic football content, per-variant tradeoffs, and a message asking the user to pick/comment. No production code.

evals.name: analytics-dashboard-desktop
evals.prompt: I'm building a self-hosted, privacy-friendly web analytics tool. I need the main dashboard: visitors over time, top pages, referrers, countries, devices, and a realtime 'people online now' counter. Show me a few layout options before I build it.
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML with 2-4 genuinely different dashboard layouts (not color swaps) in tabs, plausible analytics numbers, tradeoffs, and a request for feedback.

evals.name: onboarding-flow-multistep
evals.prompt: app per imparare il giapponese leggendo manga, mi serve l'onboarding: l'utente sceglie livello JLPT (o 'non lo so'), generi preferiti, obiettivo giornaliero in minuti. come lo faresti? voglio vedere delle alternative
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML with alternative onboarding flows (e.g. stepper vs single scroll vs conversational) showing the relevant steps/states, mobile frame, realistic Japanese/manga content, tradeoffs, and a feedback request.
